dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Smiles and laughter everywhere I look... it's contagious.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I can almost feel the music in the air... I have the urge to start waving my conductor's baton...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... I'm glad that you're enjoying the city!
